annotations.text:
Mobile-first Pulse at 390x844, built on the existing tokens (IBM Plex Sans and Mono, the paper and grey ramps, the amber flag and red alarm).

The change from today: rows stack instead of forming three squeezed columns. Line 1 carries the name and the amount, line 2 the row count and the comparison. Amounts stay right-aligned so the column still scans. Every row and control is at least 44px tall.

Sample figures are invented and reconcile: 3.450,00 in, 1.918,97 out, 300,00 to reserves, 1.231,03 change in the pot.

Alternate direction, beside the main one rather than instead of it: one continuous ledger, one line per merchant, about twice as much on screen. The cost is that the comparison with last month moves behind a tap.
